title: Wave HP regression: later waves frequently weaker than earlier ones
detail: 13 wave_hp_regression anomalies detected across 8 sessions. Specific patterns: wave 7 avgHP < wave 6 (5 occurrences), wave 8 avgHP < wave 7 (3 occurrences), wave 10 avgHP < wave 9 (3 occurrences), wave 12 avgHP < wave 11 (1 occurrence). Examples: wave 7 avgHP=31 vs wave 6 avgHP=94 (67% drop), wave 8 avgHP=33 vs wave 7 avgHP=90 (63% drop), wave 10 avgHP=53 vs wave 9 avgHP=126 (58% drop). This non-monotonic HP scaling creates difficulty spikes followed by easy waves, breaking pacing. The regression likely happens when a high-HP archetype wave (e.g. tank/armored) is followed by a low-HP archetype wave (e.g. swarm/runner). The wave composition system may not account for total wave EHP when mixing archetypes.

suggested_fix.description: Apply a minimum avgHP floor per wave that is monotonically increasing: avgHP(wave N) >= avgHP(wave N-1) * 0.8. When wave composition picks low-HP archetypes (swarm/runner), compensate by spawning more enemies or applying an HP multiplier to maintain the floor. Alternatively, sort wave templates by effective HP and ensure ascending order.
